security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG implements vle8/vle16/vle32/vle64 or vse8/vse16/vse32/vse64 without properly applying vstart offset to element indexing (start_bit_pos = (vstart + i) * element_width), causing writes to wrong vector register bit positions. Additionally, QEMU sign-extends vle8 loads (the spec uses plain read_memory<8> without sext, i.e. unsigned/zero-extended) or derives element width from CSR vsew instead of the instruction's fixed intrinsic width.
security_spec.summary: Unit-stride vector loads/stores must use fixed per-instruction element width (not vsew), apply vstart offset to element indexing for bit-accurate register writes with undisturbed policy, and treat vle8 as unsigned (no sign-extension); any deviation corrupts guest vector register state
